description: HighLevel is a CRM and sales/marketing automation platform for agencies and businesses. It combines contacts, messaging, calendars, payments, workflows, and related business operations in one system.
summary: GoHighLevel exposes a versioned REST API at `services.leadconnectorhq.com` plus an MCP server at `services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/`; both use either OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens or Private Integration Tokens.
